/color/roles/color.ink_muted.why: no muted ink is observed; a neutral between the black ink and the grey accent, for source lines and axis labels

/color/roles/color.surface_alt.why: the light grey panel fill covers 31% of painted area (sensitivity table bands on slides 4 and 10)

/color/roles/color.accent3.why: the master carries the house palette as swatch rectangles: 17-61-99, 204-209-215 (observed as accent1), 94-124-158, 72-80-89

/typography/roles/type.kicker.why: section labels above exhibits; caption size, bold, caps, in the house blue

/typography/roles/type.footnote.why: the reference's smallest text is its 10pt notes; the annotation floor is 10

/typography/roles/type.source_line.why: same size as the 10pt captions the reference uses for notes

/typography/roles/type.table_header.why: the label boxes on slide 3 are white bold text on the deep blue

/typography/roles/type.table_cell.why: body size; the body floor is 12

/tables.why: no table in the reference; the slide 3 label boxes (blue fill, white bold text) and the slide 4 sensitivity grids (grey bands, thin rules) set the pattern

/charts.why: no native chart in the reference; flat register, no gridlines, labels on bars like the sensitivity figures

/imagery/register_kind: screenshots and logos, wide crops, no frames

/description.summary: A restrained banker's deck: black Arial on white, a deep blue (113D63) full-width rule under the title and a blue block at the left edge on every page, light grey panels for sensitivity grids, the bank name in blue at the foot, one message per page in a 24pt plain title.
/description.typography: Arial throughout; 24pt regular titles that run to two lines when needed, 12pt body in square-bullet lists, bold 12pt for emphasis inside a sentence, 10pt for notes and sources. No italics, no caps except short labels.
/description.color: White pages, black text; deep blue for structure (rule, left block, label boxes, header fills) and for the footer name; light grey for panel fills and secondary bars; red appears once as a highlight line and is not a palette colour.
/description.layout: A consistent left margin of 0.42in; title band at the top; content either one full-width text block or a label column beside explanatory bullets; exhibits sit right with text left; generous bottom margin above the footer rule.
/description.tables: Flat grids: blue header band with white bold text, thin grey interior rules, no outer border, figures right-aligned, labels left.
/description.imagery: Pasted exhibits (screenshots of models) spanning the content width, no frames or shadows.
/description.motifs: The top rule and the left block are the page signature; label boxes are solid blue rectangles with white text; nothing is rounded, nothing has an effect.
never_does: colour bars that are not the top rule or left block

/derivation_rules: Extend the palette by stepping the deep blue towards the grey: 113D63 -> 5E7C9E -> CCD1D7; never introduce a new hue.
New text roles take a size from the ladder 10 / 12 / 15 / 19 / 24; weight 700 only for emphasis, h2 and table headers.
Any new component is drawn flat with rect geometry, blue header treatment and grey panels, ruled with 0.5pt grey lines.

/color/roles/color.accent2.why: the deep-blue house swatch 17-61-99 on the master; the draft observes the same hex as color.rule (the top rule and left block)

/color/roles/color.positive.why: no green appears anywhere in the deck and it never colours a figure as favourable; a positive figure takes the house deep blue (the observed color.rule) so it reads in the house palette

/color/roles/color.negative.why: the only saturated non-blue in the deck: the red outline that flags the adverse figure (one rule vote in the draft's usage pools)
